name: Sidebar
description: A collapsible app sidebar that shrinks to an icon rail, with sections, badges, a user footer and an animated active item. The base for dashboards and SaaS app shells.
author: wensity
oQueDa: Sidebar que recolhe para trilho de ícones, com seções, badges e usuário (MIT, Base UI).
ondeVai: Alternativa de sidebar (mais completa, badges de prazos).
adaptacaoMarca: Usa @base-ui/react e @tabler/icons-react (padronizar ícones numa só lib).
compat: React 19/Next 16/Tailwind v4: revisar 'use client', trocar framer-motion por motion/react quando aparecer; cores hardcoded → tokens do globals.css.
